zgs.fieldSemantics: Base lzskdvXX = tree-group percentage of stand growing stock. Not canopy cover, cell area share or mushroom suitability. All *_m regeneration fields excluded from analysis.

reuse.status: Published section 5 specifies mandatory source attribution for reuse of all public information. Section 3.c exempts attribution-only reuse from a written reuse decision. This is the basis for storing and distributing the derived pilot aggregation with attribution.
reuse.limits: No CC/open-license label is asserted for ZGS. No ownership data or raw stand geometry is distributed. Recheck current terms before a wider/commercial rollout or a changed source.

limitations: Acquisition date is not survey vintage; per-stand observation date is unavailable in this schema.
A positive pine share applies to a whole stand and does not locate pine within that stand.
Data cover Slovenian stands; the pilot also crosses the national border.
Valid zero shares, missing values, low coverage and lack of stand coverage remain distinguishable.
Weather scores remain unchanged. ZGS evidence is used only by Lactarius and Boletus habitat policies.

boletusHabitatMethod.unmappedReason: Aggregated broadleaf groups cannot identify these genera independently.
boletusHabitatMethod.semantics: Area-weighted sum of stand growing-stock shares; never canopy cover or weather-score bonus.
boletusHabitatMethod.missingPolicy: Sum valid fields as a known lower bound; all missing remains null. Any incomplete/invalid intersecting host stand keeps wooded cell unknown.
boletusHabitatMethod.coverage: Reuse pine-valid zgsDataCoverageFraction, with complete five-group requirement for candidate eligibility.
boletusHabitatMethod.heuristic: wooded >=0.30 AND coverage >=0.30 AND (host share >=10 OR union evidence area >=0.20), no incomplete/invalid host stands, overlap <=0.001
